status: Secondary exploratory extension requested by user during the primary frozen experiment; specified without inspecting confirmation cohort scores. Does not replace the primary ASE iteration or its hypothesis.
idea: Business-boundary-aware message passing over latent expert reliability, not decomposition of sales into causal factors.

gate_training.target: per-day absolute errors divided by each store validation-window mean sales, then centered across experts
gate_training.features: known future promo/open/holidays/calendar/horizon; historical volatility/trend; model disagreement; no store-ID, future sales or future Customers
gate_training.model: standardized Ridge alpha=100, no hyperparameter search

message_graph.boundary_mask: 1 only if both days open and promo, school holiday, state holiday are unchanged
message_graph.selection: minimum mean WAPE at origin 774 on original 400 stores; keep 732-trained gate without refit

ablations: lambda=0, same trained gate and temperature
constant temporal coupling at chosen lambda, still cut closed-day links
shuffled business boundaries at same lambda, fixed seed 20261020

evaluation.metric: mean per-store WAPE, then mean across windows
evaluation.bootstrap: paired store clusters, 4000 draws, descriptive 95% CI; exploratory comparisons not confirmatory novelty evidence

novelty_limit: HMM experts, state-dependent forecast combinations and contextual gating are prior art. Only the specific business-boundary prior and its usefulness are investigated; no first-in-literature claim.
